slides.photo_prompt: Photorealistic lifestyle photo, vertical 4:5. A Korean woman in her 20s sitting on the edge of a neatly made bed in the evening, face out of frame, hands laying out a simple party outfit and a small clutch bag next to a folded silk scarf, a glass of water and a softly lit candle on the nightstand, warm string lights blurred in the background. Soft peach and cream color palette, soft natural light, clean minimal set, shallow depth of field, editorial beauty magazine style. No text, no logos, no product packaging, no pills or medicine, no before-and-after, no visible skin conditions.

Big party tomorrow? Start tonight ✨

Last-minute outfit scrolling and a busy, salty evening can push bedtime late and make the morning feel rushed.
Try three small habits tonight:
A. Lay out your outfit early · B. Light dinner and water · C. Simple skincare, then lights low
